intro.p1: Your privacy is critically important to us (Farmicon)

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p1: It is Farmicon's policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect while operating our website. This Privacy Policy applies to https://www.farmicon.in/ (hereinafter, "us", "we", or "https://www.farmicon.in/"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting personally identifiable information you may provide us through the Website. We have adopted this privacy policy ("Privacy Policy") to explain what information may be collected on our website, how we use this information, and under what circumstances we may disclose the information to third parties. This Privacy Policy applies only to information we collect through the Website and does not apply to our collection of information from other sources.

websiteVisitors.title: Website Visitors
websiteVisitors.p1: Like most website operators, Farmicon collects non-personally identifying information of the sort that web browsers and servers typically make available, such as the browser type, language preference, referring site, and the date and time of each visitor request. Farmicon's purpose in collecting non-personally identifying information is to better understand how Farmicon's visitors use its website. From time to time, Farmicon may release non-personally identifying information in the aggregate, e.g., by publishing a report on trends in the usage of its website.
websiteVisitors.p2: Farmicon also collects potentially personally identifying information like Internet Protocol (IP) addresses for logged in users and for users leaving comments on https://www.farmicon.in/ blog posts. Farmicon only discloses logged in user and commenter IP addresses under the same circumstances that it uses and discloses personally identifying information as described below.

signUp.title: Sign Up for Our Service
signUp.p1: If you sign up for our service, we will ask you for your name and phone number. The purpose of the processing is to allow you access to our services and to provide the services to you. The purpose is additionally to reach you with important notifications and updates regarding the service.
signUp.subTitle: Gathering Of Personally Identifying Information
signUp.p2: Certain visitors to Farmicon's websites choose to interact with Farmicon in ways that require Farmicon to gather personally identifying information. The amount and type of information that Farmicon gathers depends on the nature of the interaction. For example, we ask visitors who sign up for a blog at https://www.farmicon.in/ to provide a username, email address, and phone number.

collection.title: Collection
collection.p1: We collect your personal data when you use our Platform, services or otherwise interact with us during the course of our relationship.

usageSection.title: Usage
usageSection.p1: We use personal data to provide the services you request. To the extent we use your personal data to market to you, we will provide you the ability to opt-out of such uses.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.p1: We may share your personal data internally within our group entities, our other corporate entities, and affiliates to provide you access to the services and products offered by them.

security.title: Security
security.p1: The security of your Personal Information is important to us but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

securityPrecautions.title: Security Precautions
securityPrecautions.p1: To protect your personal data from unauthorised access or disclosure, loss or misuse we adopt reasonable security practices and procedures.

advertisements.title: Advertisements
advertisements.p1: Ads appearing on our website may be delivered to users by advertising partners, who may set cookies. These cookies allow the ad server to recognize your computer each time they send you an online advertisement to compile information about you or others who use your computer.

externalLinks.title: Links To External Sites
externalLinks.p1: Our Service may contain links to external sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy and terms and conditions of every site you visit.
externalLinks.p2: https://www.farmicon.in Uses Google AdWords for Remarketing
externalLinks.p3: https://www.farmicon.in/ uses the remarketing services to advertise on third-party websites (including Google) to previous visitors to our site. It could mean that we advertise to previous visitors who haven't completed a task on our site, for example using the contact form to make an enquiry.
externalLinks.p4: You can set preferences for how Google advertises to you using the Google Ad Preferences page, and if you want to, you can opt out of interest-based advertising entirely by cookie settings or permanently using a browser plugin.

protection.title: Protection Of Certain Personally Identifying Information
protection.p1: Farmicon discloses potentially personally identifying and personally identifying information only to those of its employees, contractors, and affiliated organizations that (i) need to know that information in order to process it on Farmicon's behalf or to provide services available at Farmicon's website, and (ii) that have agreed not to disclose it to others.
protection.p2: If you are a registered user of https://www.farmicon.in/ and have supplied your email address, Farmicon may occasionally send you an email to tell you about new features, solicit your feedback, or just keep you up to date with what's going on with Farmicon and our products.

aggregatedStatistics.title: Aggregated Statistics
aggregatedStatistics.p1: Farmicon may collect statistics about the behavior of visitors to its website. Farmicon may display this information publicly or provide it to others. However, Farmicon does not disclose your personally identifying information.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: To enrich and perfect your online experience, Farmicon uses "Cookies", similar technologies, and services provided by others to display personalized content, appropriate advertising, and store your preferences on your computer.
cookies.p2: A cookie is a string of information that a website stores on a visitor's computer, and that the visitor's browser provides to the website each time the visitor returns.
cookies.p3: By continuing to navigate our website without changing your cookie settings, you hereby acknowledge and agree to Farmicon's use of cookies.

businessTransfers.title: Business Transfers
businessTransfers.p1: If Farmicon, or substantially all of its assets, were acquired, or in the unlikely event that Farmicon goes out of business or enters bankruptcy, user information would be one of the assets that is transferred or acquired by a third party.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion and Retention
dataDeletion.p1: You have an option to delete your account by visiting your profile and settings on our Platform , this action would result in you losing all information related to your account.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.p1: You may access, rectify, and update your personal data directly through the functionalities provided on the Platform.

consent.title: Consent
consent.p1: By visiting our Platform or by providing your information, you consent to the collection, use, storage, disclosure and otherwise processing of your information on the Platform in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

locationData.title: Location Data
locationData.p1: We may use and store information about your location if you give us permission to do so ("Location Data"). We use this data to provide features of our Service, to improve and customize our Service.
locationData.p2: You can enable or disable location services when you use our Service at any time by way of your device settings.

refundPolicyContent.intro: This refund and cancellation policy outlines how you can cancel or seek a refund for a product / service that you have purchased through the Platform. Under this policy:

cancellation.li1: Cancellations will only be considered if the request is made 7 days of placing the order. However, cancellation requests may not be entertained if the orders have been communicated to such sellers / merchant(s) listed on the Platform and they have initiated the process of shipping them, or the product is out for delivery. In such an event, you may choose to reject the product at the doorstep.
cancellation.li2: Farmicon India Private Limited does not accept cancellation requests for perishable items like flowers, eatables, etc. However, the refund / replacement can be made if the user establishes that the quality of the product delivered is not good.
cancellation.li3: In case of receipt of damaged or defective items, please report to our customer service team. The request would be entertained once the seller/ merchant listed on the Platform, has checked and determined the same at its own end. This should be reported within 7 days of receipt of products.
cancellation.li4: In case you feel that the product received is not as shown on the site or as per your expectations, you must bring it to the notice of our customer service within 7 days of receiving the product. The customer service team after looking into your complaint will take an appropriate decision.
cancellation.li5: In case of complaints regarding the products that come with a warranty from the manufacturers, please refer the issue to them.

return.title: Return Policy
return.p1: We offer refund / exchange within first 7 days from the date of your purchase. If 7 days have passed since your purchase, you will not be offered a return, exchange or refund of any kind. In order to become eligible for a return or an exchange, (i) the purchased item should be unused and in the same condition as you received it, (ii) the item must have original packaging, (iii) if the item that you purchased on a sale, then the item may not be eligible for a return / exchange. Further, only such items are replaced by us (based on an exchange request), if such items are found defective or damaged.
return.p2: You agree that there may be a certain category of products / items that are exempted from returns or refunds. Such categories of the products would be identified to you at the item of purchase. For exchange / return accepted request(s) (as applicable), once your returned product / item is received and inspected by us, we will send you an email to notify you about receipt of the returned / exchanged product. Further. If the same has been approved after the quality check at our end, your request (i.e. return / exchange) will be processed in accordance with our policies.

advertisements.p1: Ads appearing on our website may be delivered to users by advertising partners, who may set cookies. These cookies allow the ad server to recognize your computer each time they send you an online advertisement to compile information about you or others who use your computer.

externalLinks.title: Links To External Sites
externalLinks.p1: Our Service may contain links to external sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy and terms and conditions of every site you visit.
externalLinks.p2: https://www.farmicon.in Uses Google AdWords for Remarketing
externalLinks.p3: https://www.farmicon.in/ uses the remarketing services to advertise on third-party websites (including Google) to previous visitors to our site. It could mean that we advertise to previous visitors who haven't completed a task on our site, for example using the contact form to make an enquiry.
externalLinks.p4: You can set preferences for how Google advertises to you using the Google Ad Preferences page, and if you want to, you can opt out of interest-based advertising entirely by cookie settings or permanently using a browser plugin.

protection.title: Protection Of Certain Personally Identifying Information
protection.p1: Farmicon discloses potentially personally identifying and personally identifying information only to those of its employees, contractors, and affiliated organizations that (i) need to know that information in order to process it on Farmicon's behalf or to provide services available at Farmicon's website, and (ii) that have agreed not to disclose it to others.
protection.p2: If you are a registered user of https://www.farmicon.in/ and have supplied your email address, Farmicon may occasionally send you an email to tell you about new features, solicit your feedback, or just keep you up to date with what's going on with Farmicon and our products.

aggregatedStatistics.title: Aggregated Statistics
aggregatedStatistics.p1: Farmicon may collect statistics about the behavior of visitors to its website. Farmicon may display this information publicly or provide it to others. However, Farmicon does not disclose your personally identifying information.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: To enrich and perfect your online experience, Farmicon uses "Cookies", similar technologies, and services provided by others to display personalized content, appropriate advertising, and store your preferences on your computer.
cookies.p2: A cookie is a string of information that a website stores on a visitor's computer, and that the visitor's browser provides to the website each time the visitor returns.
cookies.p3: By continuing to navigate our website without changing your cookie settings, you hereby acknowledge and agree to Farmicon's use of cookies.

businessTransfers.title: Business Transfers
businessTransfers.p1: If Farmicon, or substantially all of its assets, were acquired, or in the unlikely event that Farmicon goes out of business or enters bankruptcy, user information would be one of the assets that is transferred or acquired by a third party.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion and Retention
dataDeletion.p1: You have an option to delete your account by visiting your profile and settings on our Platform , this action would result in you losing all information related to your account.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.p1: You may access, rectify, and update your personal data directly through the functionalities provided on the Platform.

consent.title: Consent
consent.p1: By visiting our Platform or by providing your information, you consent to the collection, use, storage, disclosure and otherwise processing of your information on the Platform in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

locationData.title: Location Data
locationData.p1: We may use and store information about your location if you give us permission to do so ("Location Data"). We use this data to provide features of our Service, to improve and customize our Service.
locationData.p2: You can enable or disable location services when you use our Service at any time by way of your device settings.

refundPolicyContent.intro: This refund and cancellation policy outlines how you can cancel or seek a refund for a product / service that you have purchased through the Platform. Under this policy:

cancellation.li1: Cancellations will only be considered if the request is made 7 days of placing the order. However, cancellation requests may not be entertained if the orders have been communicated to such sellers / merchant(s) listed on the Platform and they have initiated the process of shipping them, or the product is out for delivery. In such an event, you may choose to reject the product at the doorstep.
cancellation.li2: Farmicon India Private Limited does not accept cancellation requests for perishable items like flowers, eatables, etc. However, the refund / replacement can be made if the user establishes that the quality of the product delivered is not good.
cancellation.li3: In case of receipt of damaged or defective items, please report to our customer service team. The request would be entertained once the seller/ merchant listed on the Platform, has checked and determined the same at its own end. This should be reported within 7 days of receipt of products.
cancellation.li4: In case you feel that the product received is not as shown on the site or as per your expectations, you must bring it to the notice of our customer service within 7 days of receiving the product. The customer service team after looking into your complaint will take an appropriate decision.
cancellation.li5: In case of complaints regarding the products that come with a warranty from the manufacturers, please refer the issue to them.

return.title: Return Policy
return.p1: We offer refund / exchange within first 7 days from the date of your purchase. If 7 days have passed since your purchase, you will not be offered a return, exchange or refund of any kind. In order to become eligible for a return or an exchange, (i) the purchased item should be unused and in the same condition as you received it, (ii) the item must have original packaging, (iii) if the item that you purchased on a sale, then the item may not be eligible for a return / exchange. Further, only such items are replaced by us (based on an exchange request), if such items are found defective or damaged.
return.p2: You agree that there may be a certain category of products / items that are exempted from returns or refunds. Such categories of the products would be identified to you at the item of purchase. For exchange / return accepted request(s) (as applicable), once your returned product / item is received and inspected by us, we will send you an email to notify you about receipt of the returned / exchanged product. Further. If the same has been approved after the quality check at our end, your request (i.e. return / exchange) will be processed in accordance with our policies.
